scope: Bounded public evidence review, primary methodology and actual public sample audit; not a systematic customer survey or independent performance study.
verification: No source in this review is classified as an independently audited Bet Angel profit record.

sources.title: Mark Iverson: From £250 to £4505 in 12 Months

sources.limitations: Unaudited; old non-horse-specific results; affiliate interest; bank growth excludes some costs.
